newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil hit by fundamental oversupply.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil hit by fundamental oversupply.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures eased into the close as traders perceived increasing supply and feeble demand in the European market, brokers said.
The Nov/Dec spread shed $1.00 to $4.00 backwardation as physical market premiums dropped.
Nov IPE gas oil fell $3.00 to close at $209.00 per tonne while Dec finished just $1.75 lower at $205.25.
"There's just too much around," a broker said. "The market's coming more into balance and that's being reflected in the price."
Gas oil's weakness was set against a steady Brent price, and the December crack spread eased by 25 cents to $5.00 per barrel.
December Brent stood 3 cents higher at $22.54 per barrel at 1818 GMT.
Brokers said the market took some support from Pentagon reports that the U.S. fired on Iraqi installations in the Iraqi "no-fly" zone on Saturday and Monday, but Iraq denied the reports.
